title: Destiny
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Wizards of the Coast short stories)

paragraphs.text: " Destiny " is a short story by Michael G. Ryan that was published in 2006 - 2007 on the now defunct Planar Chaos mini-site.

"Destiny" tells an alternate version of events of the Weatherlight Saga where during the fight with Selenia it is Mirri who strikes the killing blow instead of Crovax . She thus becomes Mirri the Cursed , and is being abandoned on Rath in the same way that Crovax had been in the normal course of events. Crovax escapes her assault along with Gerrard and blames himself for Mirri's condition.
